parent.behavior_scope: accepted FAST upstream one-spare route with two-hour down and up transit

source.source_boundary: The manual documents stock allocation, backorder handling and FAST general support links. The exact native response when both base and depot begin with no spare, but a faulty installed item can travel to depot repair, must be observed.

delta.mechanism: Set only DEPOT-01 initial LRU stock from one to zero; retain BASE-01 stock zero, FAST link, two-hour bidirectional transport, one-hour depot ItemRepair, seed and missions.

design_expected_if_repaired_item_fulfill.basis: The accepted parent's seed exposed the first failure at 9.8829 hours; these times are a hand calculation conditional on the same native event and repair routing, not an assertion about the engine's choice.

predeclared_native_acceptance: Import/export and calculation must have zero conversion errors; four CLI steps must succeed and 21 row-containing source tables, including three all-null placeholders, must roundtrip. If the native engine rejects this route, retain the failed probe and classify the limitation rather than publishing behavior.

The first local stockout must be traced through base demand/backorder and FAST depot demand. Confirm depot initial stock zero, absence of a fictitious issue, and the number and location of any backorders.

Trace the identity of the removed faulty LRU from aircraft through two-hour upward transport to depot repair and disposition: issue against a pending backorder or entry into depot stock. Determine whether the repaired item fulfills any pending upstream demand and travels downward; if so, verify physical item identity, every transit start/arrival, base backorder clearance, fit and aircraft readiness.

Reconcile the full event and stock ledger with 72 half-hour report intervals, failures, repairs, demands, backorder and item-wait integrals, mission outcomes and terminal stocks/transit. Compare to accepted E04 FAST stocked-depot control without attributing stochastic timing differences to stock alone.

Keep the source and native raw hashes sealed under session-0 SSH, host-wide queue and GUI PID 13340 guard. Require independent prelaunch review and read-only raw replay before a bounded publication decision.
limits: This one zero-stock depot probe does not establish stock replenishment from an additional echelon, FIFO across multiple backorders, SLOW ordering, lateral support or automated reorder.
Exact stochastic failure time is run-specific.
